method: Stream all canonical games through DatasetReader; compare the previous Masters snapshot with new games whose sidecar includes Source=LichessBroadcastAPI. Game sequences use exact CompactMove vectors. Player names use codb-curate's existing normalization. Date comparison normalizes separators; year comparison is a broad candidate signal. Event and round remove non-alphanumeric ASCII characters and lowercase. No candidate is automatically deduplicated from this audit.
deduplication_decision: No cross-release deletion or merge was performed. Exact stable-ID and full metadata/move matches are direct overlap signals; move-only and relaxed metadata matches require manual review because equal moves alone do not prove the games are the same event record.
limitations: The source tag is publisher-supplied provenance; the audit does not independently authenticate Lichess origin.
Player normalization intentionally follows existing deduplication behavior and may not catch every spelling or identity mismatch.
No raw PGN, player names, event names, or game IDs are written to this aggregate report.
